message: Last winter, we had a surprise snowstorm that knocked out the power just as I was settling in for my favorite movie. Thankfully, I had filled a few containers with water and set aside some battery-operated lights earlier in the week. It turned out to be a cozy evening with candlelight, hot cocoa, and a game of cards by the fireplace instead. Sometimes, a little prep can turn a stormy night into a lovely memory. Have you had a small win like that?
